scope: 51 individually examined extracted members. Outer archives retain prior convictions.
method: Static source execution-path tracing, Base64/Gzip/Deflate reconstruction, CLR IL body disassembly with resolved metadata tokens, native PE export/import/call disassembly, and manual ARM64 XOR/PRNG command reconstruction. No sample was executed. atomscan and cleave facts run per member and archive.
context: Empire and DAVTest are recognizable offensive testing tools, and the source-package layout is compatible with authorized security work. The judgments concern these callable attack payloads individually, including covert control, credential extraction, exploitation and webshell access; they do not assert that legitimate libraries or all package files are malicious. No host telemetry, exercise authorization, operator configuration, victim information or runtime success was supplied. No archive verdict was inherited.
trait_edits: Relocated 21 registered wallet-extension ID observations and two neutral ID-set composites from application identity to browser-extension runtime identity references; preserved matchers, type/platform/size gates, severities, suppression and needs semantics. Updated exact consumers. Moved the existing Coinbase Solana adapter exception to library context so neutral traits do not depend on an objective. Ancestor identity selectors intentionally cease treating target references as evidence the containing file is an installed app.
coverage_gaps: SweetPotato, dumpCredStore, SpoolSample, SharpLoginPrompt and the native stager have multiple accurate hostile findings, but some are overlapping identity/wrapper findings for one principal attack behavior. These are retained; no duplicate or invented independent objective was added merely to meet a numerical minimum. Generic decoding/loading/process APIs remain notable, not artificially hostile.

validation_evidence.semantics: All 24 moved effective definitions compare exactly after ID remapping and description changes.
validation_evidence.focused_check: check.py passed four cases: ID catalog, mutated IDs, ConnectKit integration and an HTTP-uploading extension-store collector.

native_extractor_variability.explanation: Initial fat Mach-O scans exposed different x64/ARM64 low-level facts. A controlled RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 rescan against a git-archive of original rules and the edited rules yielded identical normalized full finding sets, not just equal hostile counts. No behavior matcher was removed.

validation_evidence.model_notice: Scanner warns model spec v18 is older than extractor v19. This is reported rather than masked by changing trait severity or duplicating attacks.

members.marker_note: WireTap: records keys, screen, camera and password-triggered audio
members.execution_trace: Gzip/Base64 -> Assembly.Load -> WireT4p.Program.Main. IL dispatch calls keyboard hook logger (also clipboard listener), screenshot CopyFromScreen/Image.Save, webcam NewFrame/Image.Save, and speech recognition -> RecordAudio.

members.marker_note: Mimikatz server: reflective LSASS dumping and NTLM credential reuse
members.execution_trace: Both Base64 native images export powershell_reflective_mimikatz. The loader maps sections/imports, clears PE magic, invokes sekurlsa::logonpasswords by default, and exposes certificate private-key bypass/export and pass-the-hash commands. Export disassembly parses command arguments and enters native dispatcher.

members.marker_note: Mimikatz test: executable LSASS dumper and pass-the-hash payload
members.execution_trace: Independent file and different 32/64-bit payload hashes/sizes from server copy; same callable reflective loader and default logonpasswords execution. It is executable attack code despite test-tree location, not a harmless mock or documentation.

members.marker_note: DCSync: loads native code to replicate domain NTLM hashes
members.execution_trace: Enumerates domain/forest users, appends krbtgt, constructs lsadump::dcsync /user:DOMAIN\\user, invokes reflective native payload, and parses Hash NTLM output. Images support Invoke/InvokeWide and reflectively load after signature erasure.

members.marker_note: BypassUAC: injects a DLL hijack and self-deleting batch launcher
members.execution_trace: Patches embedded TPGenProc DLL with batch path; Write-HijackDll writes payload. Inject-BypassStuff allocates/writes/starts reflective code in a target process and stages a DLL under sysprep for auto-elevation; batch launcher deletes itself and temporary DLL is removed.

members.marker_note: PowerBreach: polls and executes encoded remote backdoor commands
members.execution_trace: Invoke-CallbackIEX downloads HTTP/HTTPS/BITS data, Base64-decodes and evaluates it. CallbackLoop polls; PortBind reads a trigger then calls back to sender; DNSLoop turns changed DNS answers into callback addresses; PacketKnock matches payload data captured through ReceiveAll and activates callback. HTTPS accepts every certificate.

members.marker_note: SweetPotato: coerces authentication and launches with stolen token
members.execution_trace: Base64 CLR assembly -> Assembly.Load -> Program.Main. IL enables privileges, triggers PotatoAPI (DCOM/WinRM/PrintSpoofer), obtains intercepted token, DuplicateTokenEx, then launches via CreateProcessWithTokenW/CreateProcessAsUserW. Mono.Options and Costura code are supporting dependencies, not evidence of malice themselves.

members.marker_note: SharpSecDump: dumps SAM hashes and remote LSA secrets
members.execution_trace: Gzip/Base64 -> managed Main -> DoStuff. IL gets boot key, RemoteOps.SaveRegKey for SAM and SECURITY, ParseSam decrypts account hashes, ParseLsa decrypts secret/cached-logon records, then formats reports. These paths support both hostile findings independently.

members.marker_note: MS16-032: races leaked thread tokens to run a SYSTEM command
members.execution_trace: Get-ThreadHandle uses CreateProcessWithLogonW with inherited current-thread std handles, duplicates leaked handle 0x4, and terminates temporary process. Get-SystemToken uses NtImpersonateThread/OpenThreadToken. Parallel token assignment races suspended process creation; successful privileged child resumes with operator command. CPU-core check supports race prerequisites, not VM evasion.

members.marker_note: Reflective VNC: covert remote desktop payload with PE magic erasure
members.execution_trace: Wrapper builds listener/reverse VNC connection arguments and reflectively maps embedded architecture-specific VNC DLLs; loader zeroes DOS signature, fixes imports and executes mapped entrypoint. Native payload contains VNC server control and display/input surfaces. Reflective injection and concealment tip judgment beyond ordinary installed VNC.

members.marker_note: Metasploit cradle: hides download-and-execute PowerShell staging
members.execution_trace: Builds certificate-accepting WebClient.DownloadString -> Invoke-Expression cradle, starts new PowerShell with -nop -c, redirects output and uses CreateNoWindow/Hidden. Payload URL remains operator supplied; no final payload or successful network access assumed.

members.marker_note: Empire PowerShell agent: encrypted task execution and file theft
members.execution_trace: Invoke-Empire processes received session task packets, AES/HMAC-protected task channel, invokes task expressions, supports jobs and operator shell commands, reads file chunks and packs/sends them as task responses. Source is a functional implant template, not an inert protocol library.

members.marker_note: SMBExec: passes NTLM hashes to execute and erase remote services
members.execution_trace: Raw SMB1/2 state machine accepts supplied NTLM hash, constructs challenge response/signing, connects svcctl pipe, opens SCM, creates command service, starts it, deletes it and closes handles. Command becomes service binary path, not mere SMB file access.

members.marker_note: CredStore dumper: enumerates and prints Credential Manager secrets
members.execution_trace: CredEnumerateW -> native CREDENTIAL pointers -> Marshal.PtrToStringUni CredentialBlob -> Enum-Creds -> CredManMain formats username, target and plaintext password. CredManMain is called by the script. Debug helper code is not the reason for conviction.

members.marker_note: NetRipper: injects interception code to capture TLS credentials
members.execution_trace: Reflective native DLL loader injects NetRipper; configurable process and plaintext/credential filters patch embedded payload settings. Native interception covers SSL read/write/plaintext recording and file logging, beyond importing an ordinary TLS library.

members.marker_note: CredentialInjection: clones SYSTEM Winlogon and injects logon code
members.execution_trace: Get-PrimaryToken duplicates a SYSTEM token, Create-SuspendedWinLogon creates privileged clone (or uses existing Winlogon), Invoke-ReflectivePEInjection maps architecture-specific VoidFunc DLL into it. Named pipe conveys domain/user/password/logon type for LsaLogonUser inside Winlogon.

members.marker_note: EventVwr bypass: hijacks auto-elevation and removes registry traces
members.execution_trace: Writes operator payload in HKCU, overrides mscfile shell open command with hidden encoded PowerShell launcher, starts eventvwr.exe, then removes hijack/payload properties and stops viewer. Administrator/medium-integrity/UAC checks constrain exploit, not benignity.

members.marker_note: PrintNightmare: replaces printer DLL to create an administrator
members.execution_trace: Builds DLL bytes from Gzip/Base64 or accepts operator DLL; patches default username/password fields, writes nightmare.dll, populates DRIVER_INFO_2.pConfigFile/pDataFile, calls AddPrinterDriverEx with copy/install flags. Native DLL contains a NetUserAdd/NetLocalGroupAddMembers routine; default account/password appear in executable setup.

members.marker_note: PrintDemon: writes a SYSTEM DLL and persists an encoded launcher
members.execution_trace: Creates printer port at System32/ualapi.dll and sends embedded PE bytes through raw WritePrinter. Installs HKCU Run hidden encoded PowerShell launcher and registry command that activates Fax and talks over loopback port 9299. Replacement DLL exports UalStart/UalStop/UalInstrument and performs named-pipe/token/process operations.

members.marker_note: SpoolSample: coerces printer authentication to a capture server
members.execution_trace: Base64 -> Assembly.Load -> SpoolSample.Program.Main(target,capture). IL constructs UNC arguments and reflectively calls DoStuff in embedded Rprn DLL; native module drives RpcOpenPrinter/RpcRemoteFindFirstPrinterChangeNotificationEx. This is authentication coercion, not printing or passive inventory.

members.marker_note: InveighRelay: captures NTLM challenges and relays SMB execution
members.execution_trace: HTTP listener issues NTLM challenges and extracts/queues NetNTLMv2 responses. Relay reuses captured authentication against SMB/SCM, creates and starts a service carrying operator command. Local file queues record captured hashes, not only generic NTLM strings.

members.marker_note: Get-System: steals SYSTEM tokens and impersonates pipe clients
members.execution_trace: Two execution paths: privileged-service named-pipe connection followed by ImpersonateNamedPipeClient, or process-token enumeration selecting SYSTEM then DuplicateToken/SetThreadToken. Both explicitly cross to SYSTEM and restore/clean context afterward.

members.marker_note: PowerDump: steals LSASS token and decrypts SAM account hashes
members.execution_trace: ElevatePrivs obtains LSASS process token, duplicates and assigns it to current thread; Get-BootKey reads LSA key classes; SAM F/V records are decoded with boot-key RC4/AES and RID-derived DES, then DumpHashes outputs LM/NT hashes.

members.marker_note: SharpChromium: decrypts saved passwords and exports session cookies
members.execution_trace: DecompressAsm -> managed ChromiumCredentialManager; wrapper GetLogins formats url/username/password and GetCookies emits JSON. IL reads Login Data/Cookies, unwraps Local State key through DPAPI and decrypts blobs through ProtectedData or BCrypt AES. History capability is also present; no external send is assumed.

members.marker_note: RIDHijacking: steals LSASS token and overwrites SAM account identity
members.execution_trace: Enable-TSDuplicateToken grants SYSTEM context using LSASS; reads SAM user F record, replaces RID bytes at offset 48 and optional enabled flag at 56, writes F back. Changes retained account authority beyond normal account enumeration.

members.marker_note: SDCLT bypass: hijacks elevated command association and cleans traces
members.execution_trace: Stores encoded payload, writes HKCU exefile shell runas IsolatedCommand with hidden PowerShell launcher, starts sdclt.exe /kickoffelev, then removes association and payload value. This is transient UAC bypass, not Run-key persistence.

members.marker_note: FodHelper bypass: hijacks DelegateExecute and removes its traces
members.execution_trace: Creates HKCU ms-settings Shell Open command; sets empty DelegateExecute and default hidden encoded PowerShell launcher; starts fodhelper.exe, then removes override and staged registry payload. Source paths independently support bypass and cleanup.

members.marker_note: EnvBypass: hijacks windir for SilentCleanup and removes its traces
members.execution_trace: Writes HKCU Environment windir to hidden PowerShell command, invokes scheduled SilentCleanup task via schtasks /Run, removes windir and staged payload afterward. This is environment-dependent auto-elevation abuse; not evidence of a durable installed task.

members.marker_note: SharpLoginPrompt: harvests and validates phished Windows passwords
members.execution_trace: Base64 CLR payload -> Program.Main; IL displays CredUIPromptForWindowsCredentials, unpacks username/password/domain, prints plaintext Password, validates credentials and repeats until valid. TopWindow keeps Windows Security prompt foremost. It is not merely an authentication UI reference.

members.marker_note: Jenkins exploit: posts remote commands and retrieves console output
members.execution_trace: Builds /script URL, POSTs URL-encoded Groovy new ProcessBuilder(operator command).redirectErrorStream(true).start().text, then extracts Result HTML. No authentication flow is implemented in the supplied function; response retrieval supports remote command execution finding.

members.marker_note: Empire IronPython agent: remote code execution and file exfiltration
members.execution_trace: process_packet dispatches task types to dynamic Python/C#/PowerShell execution, file read/chunk response and file write. Assembly.Load of decompressed operator bytes followed by reflective Main.Invoke executes managed tasks. Main loop polls task handler with jitter and working-hours/kill-date controls.

members.marker_note: Empire Python agent: remote shell tasking and file exfiltration
members.execution_trace: process_packet dispatches received task data to compile/exec and shell=True subprocess helpers; captures stdout into response packets. file_download reads local chunks, compresses/Base64 encodes and sends; file_upload appends operator-supplied bytes. Jittered loop receives/decodes routing packets.

members.marker_note: Get-Keystrokes: records translated keys with window and timestamps
members.execution_trace: Loops over virtual-key codes, GetAsyncKeyState checks press transitions, GetKeyboardState/MapVirtualKey/ToUnicode translate input. Foreground handle resolves window title, timestamps and characters emitted to pipeline. It records input, rather than implementing application hotkeys.

members.marker_note: JBoss exploit: deploys remote WAR and triggers its JSP payload
members.execution_trace: HEAD request to JMX HtmlAdaptor invokes jboss.system MainDeployer method with operator WAR URL; after delay GETs application JSP path to activate deployed code. Optional HTTPS bypass is real; no claim about unavailable final WAR contents.

members.marker_note: PowerSploit Persistence: conceals script in profiles and WMI hooks
members.execution_trace: Add-Persistence compresses/encodes script, generates eval/decompression wrapper, hides it after 600 spaces in PowerShell profile, generates WMI subscriptions, Run keys and scheduled task triggers plus removal script. Install-SSP registers and loads supplied SSP DLL. Offensive concealment and reactivation tip judgment despite removal support.

members.marker_note: Tater: poisons name resolution and reflects NTLM for SYSTEM exec
members.execution_trace: NBNS response spoofer guesses transaction IDs and coerces local HTTP/WPAD authentication; HTTP/NTLM state machine reflects authentication to local SMB service manager and starts operator command as a service. Credential capture and local elevation are distinct supported results.

members.marker_note: NTLMExtract: impersonates SYSTEM and decrypts local SAM hashes
members.execution_trace: Invoke-AsSystem duplicates/impersonates privileged process token; Get-NTLMLocalPasswordHashes reads SAM F/V records and LSA key classes, AES/RC4 unwraps keys/hashes then DES with RID-derived keys. Final call runs extraction within SYSTEM impersonation.

members.marker_note: Empire native stager: downloads code and executes it as a fiber
members.execution_trace: main passes templated host/port/path/cookie to WinHTTP buffer download; success buffer goes directly to ExecuteShellcode, VirtualAlloc RWX/memcpy, CreateFiber with buffer as entrypoint and SwitchToFiber. HTTPS ignores certificate failures. C source is an active stager template, not Windows SDK library code.

members.marker_note: DomainPasswordSpray: guesses domain passwords while avoiding lockouts
members.execution_trace: Enumerates domain users/password policies and per-user badpwdcount/last-failure data, excludes imminent lockouts, repeatedly binds DirectoryEntry with one candidate password across accounts and records valid usernames/passwords. Lockout handling limits damage but does not change its credential attack purpose.

members.marker_note: ChromeDump: queries browser logins and exports decrypted passwords
members.execution_trace: Loads legitimate embedded System.Data.SQLite implementation; enumerates user Chrome Login Data/History stores, SELECT * FROM logins, DPAPI Unprotect password_value as CurrentUser, formats URL/user/password and optionally writes plaintext file. SQLite code itself is benign; wrapper performs targeted credential collection.

members.marker_note: Inveigh: poisons name resolution and captures NTLM password material
members.execution_trace: LLMNR/NBNS/mDNS responses steer peers; HTTP listener challenges clients, raw SMB sniffer parses NTLM handshakes, constructs NetNTLMv1/v2 hash records and queues/writes them. It captures authentication material beyond passive network troubleshooting.

members.marker_note: CredentialPhisher: impersonates applications to capture passwords
members.execution_trace: Loads PhishWinLib, creates application-branded toast/credential prompt, optionally hides application windows, unpacks native credential buffer, validates and reprompts, then returns Phished credentials including plaintext password. Notification and credential-form APIs alone are not the conviction evidence.

members.marker_note: USB keylogger: captures ETW keys with foreground-window attribution
members.execution_trace: Raw Deflate/Base64 decompresses to 624640-byte CLR assembly. Wrapper starts UsbEventSource.startkeyLog and drains keysPressed queue, correlating title/time and emitting typed strings. IL attaches TraceEventSession providers and enqueues decoded USB reports. This is ETW use, not disabling ETW.

members.marker_note: Token UAC bypass: steals elevated context to launch PowerShell
members.execution_trace: Enumerates high-integrity process tokens (integrity RID 12288), DuplicateTokenEx, lowers integrity via NtSetInformationToken, filters token, duplicates impersonation token, ImpersonateLoggedOnUser then CreateProcessWithLogonW. Optional hidden TaskMgr runas creates high-integrity source and is terminated after use.

members.marker_note: MS16-135: corrupts bitmap pointers and copies the SYSTEM token
members.execution_trace: Builds adjacent manager/worker bitmap objects, abuses SetWindowLongPtr/SetParent/focus on crafted windows to corrupt spmenu and expand bitmap access. GetBitmapBits/SetBitmapBits yield arbitrary kernel R/W; traverses EPROCESS links, writes SYSTEM token into child and sends operator command over named pipe.

members.marker_note: ExecuteMSBuild: runs encoded PowerShell through MSBuild and WMI
members.execution_trace: Generates CodeTaskFactory XML with Base64 command and in-process PowerShell Runspace pipeline AddScript/Invoke; writes local or admin-share XML, launches MSBuild through Win32_Process.Create via WMI, removes staged XML. Default LAUNCHER placeholder does not negate operator-command execution path.

members.marker_note: FoxDump: decrypts Firefox logins and stages plaintext credentials
members.execution_trace: Loads nss3.dll from browser install, NSS_Init with default profile, reads logins.json, Base64-decodes encryptedUsername/encryptedPassword into SECItems and PK11SDR_Decrypt. Formats URL/user/password to pipeline or ASCII file; does not establish external exfiltration.

members.marker_note: ASP webshell: executes posted commands and deletes output traces
members.execution_trace: Request.Form(.CMD) -> szCMD -> WScript.Shell.Run(cmd.exe /c plus command redirected to random temp file); reads output and sends HTMLEncode to Response, deletes temporary file. No authentication or command restrictions.

members.marker_note: PHP webshell: request-driven shell commands, file access and upload
members.execution_trace: $_REQUEST[c] -> system; f selects fopen/fpassthru; d selects directory traversal/listing; upload moves client-supplied file into requested directory; supplied SQL is executed with requested connection credentials. Interface exposes reusable unauthenticated command/file access.

members.marker_note: Perl CGI webshell: executes query text and returns command output
members.execution_trace: QUERY_STRING -> percent substitutions (%20 and %3b) -> interpolated backticks into @cmd -> print lines as HTML response. URL query becomes arbitrary shell command; not a fixed diagnostic command.

members.marker_note: macOS stealer: phishes and uploads secrets; fix target-ID traits
members.execution_trace: ARM64 main decrypts embedded command then calls system. XOR uses seed 0x11667, state=(state*0x3785 mod 2^32) mod 35999 and byte XOR over 37077-byte constant. Decoded osascript builds AppleScript, validates/phishes device password with dscl, copies browser/wallet/keychain/notes data into temp dir, ditto zips, curl --data-binary sends archive, cleans staging, replaces Ledger Live and installs password-authorized LaunchDaemon. URLs and credentials were not contacted or submitted.
members.rule_change: Wallet ID references relocated; raw matching semantics preserved.
